info.name: Babylon citizen profile
info.description: Hand-sent, no scripts. The expected result is in each request Description.

request.description:
Seed first: node scripts/seed.department.js. Token: npm run token --silent -- citizen citizen@babylon.test.
Expect 200. data has name, email, role "citizen", department null, phone, phoneVerified, address, division, identity {status "not-submitted", nidLast4 "", submittedAt null, reason ""}, isVerified false, jobTitle, employeeId, onboarded.
Expect 401, code "unauthorized".
Expect 403, code "forbidden". Use a department token.
Expect 200 and the saved profile. Phone and email in the body are ignored.
Expect 400, code "invalid". Nothing changes.
Expect 200. data {phone "01812345678", resendIn 30}. The phone is not saved yet.
Send right after request 06. Expect 429, code "too-many-requests", field "phone".
Expect 400, code "invalid", field "phone", message "This number is already verified." Works on a fresh seed.
Expect 400, code "invalid", field "phone".
Expect 401.
Send after request 06 (dev code mode). Expect 200. data.phone "01812345678", phoneVerified true.
Send after a fresh request 06. Expect 400, code "invalid", field "code", message shows tries left. Send it 3 times in a row: the 3rd gives 423, code "locked".
Expect 400, code "invalid", field "code".
Fresh seed. Expect 200. data.identity {status "pending", nidLast4 "4821", submittedAt a date}. No photo in the answer.
Expected: 400. success false, code invalid, field photo.
Expected: 403. success false, code forbidden.
Send after request 14. Expect 409, code "conflict".
Expect 400, code "invalid", field "nidLast4".
Expect 400, code "invalid", field "photo".
Expect 400, code "invalid", field "photo".
Expect 401.
Expected: 200. data.checked true, data.matches has 1 item with similarity near 1. No imageEmbedding in the match. Needs CLIP on and a filed report in the citizen's division.
Expected: 429. success false, code too-many-requests. Send the valid body 11 times within 60 seconds.
Expected: 200. data.checked false, data.matches empty list. CLIP_ENABLED=false in backend/.env.
Expected: 400. success false, code invalid, field photoUrl.
Expected: 400. success false, code invalid, field photoUrl

Expected: 200. data.checked true, data.matches empty list.
